# Plotly — Plot & Housing Society Software for Pakistan
> Every plot. Every rupee. Accounted for.

Plotly is web-based housing society and plot developer software built for Pakistan. It replaces scattered registers and Excel spreadsheets with one central, role-controlled ledger covering plots, customer bookings, monthly installments, bank-confirmed vouchers, refunds, dealer commissions, staff salaries, petty cash, loans, land investments, and a self-service customer portal.

## Key Business Rules
- **Bank-confirmed Paid state**: Money counts as `Paid` only after bank confirmation via the voucher's unique consumer number. Unconfirmed vouchers remain `Awaiting` so collection figures are never overstated.
- **Zero double-booking**: Project names are unique, block names are unique inside a project, and plot numbers are unique inside a block. Booked plots lock immediately and only return to available inventory upon a formal refund/return.
- **Automatic voucher generation**: Saving a booking, monthly installment, or extra charge (Development Charges, Transfer Fee, Possession Charges, Membership Fee) creates a printable voucher with a unique consumer number.
- **One-step cancellation & refund**: Cancelling a booking calculates confirmed payments minus deductions, marks the booking and entries `(Returned)` without distorting historical collections, releases the plot, and tracks refund payouts in parts.
- **CNIC-deduplicated dealers**: Dealer commissions automatically link to or create a dealer record by CNIC so duplicate dealer entries do not occur.

## Core Modules (14 Areas)
1. Dashboard (role-scoped summary figures)
2. Access Control (custom staff roles and screen/action permissions)
3. Definition / Setup (projects, blocks, plot sizes, charge types, payment methods, expense types)
4. Plot Management (master plot inventory and booked/available state)
5. Customer Management (bookings, discounts, advances, monthly installments, extra charges, vouchers)
6. Bank Payment Collection (direct bank voucher lookup and confirmation; toggleable per society)
7. Refund & Release (net refund math, installment payouts, automatic plot release)
8. Dealer Commission (CNIC-unique dealer tracking by project, block, plot)
9. Employee Management (salary history and monthly payroll)
10. Petty Cash Expenses (categorized expenses with attached receipt photos in PDF reports)
11. Society Loans (borrower tracking by unique phone number and loan repayments)
12. Land Investment (seller records, witnesses, and installment payments for land purchases)
13. Reports (14 screen and printable PDF reports including Society Cash Flow)
14. Customer Portal (phone-number login for buyers to inspect plots, installments, charges, and print PDFs)
